verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a warehouse-native Identity Resolution product that links related records and a person's identifiers into one resolved identity across devices and channels. Event SDKs with identify/track calls feed that data, and a Golden Record table uses survivorship rules to choose canonical values. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of anonymous-to-known (anonymous ID) stitching, detail on configurable matching/merge rules beyond survivorship, independent or hands-on corroboration.
